'''Freedom Flight''' was an organization secretly created by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]] in [[38 ABY]] with the false objective of the elimination of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Lecersen's true objective was to aid in the [[Lecersen Conspiracy|Imperial-Alliance conspiracy's]] rise to power in the galaxy by creating more uprisings throughout the galaxy than [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] would be able to handle, leading to her downfall. However, due to the Freedom Flight's structure, wherein each operative only knew a few other beings in the organization, the majority of its members worked simply to free individuals from slavery and help them begin new lives. Also, if a member of Freedom Flight was captured, the being could only betray a few other members. When communicating, the organization referred to things using aviation terms such as flight path, [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], and cargo, so that anyone who overheard them would not be suspicious.<ref name="FotJ:A" />

The movement was behind the [[Blaudu Sextus revolt|revolts]] on [[Blaudu Sextus]] and arranged for [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Madhi Vaandt]] to be present so as to show the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]' brutality in putting down the movement. When the situation reached the ears of the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]], they concluded that Freedom Flight had to have a spy in Daala's office, as no one knew that she was using Mandalorians to put down the movement. During the suppression of the slave movements, the Mandalorians discovered Lecersen's involvement, which eventually was learned by Daala through [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="FotJ:V">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>
